subject: Emotions
title: What Is Awe
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is Awe.

hook.text: Standing at the Grand Canyon, people go silent. Words fail. Something vast overwhelms the usual self.

buildup.text: Dacher Keltner defines awe as the feeling when you face something vast that defies your current understanding.

discovery.text: Awe shrinks the ego. Brain scans show the default mode network—the 'me' network—quiets during awe.

twist.text: Awe doesn't need grandeur. Watching a baby take first steps or hearing a perfect melody triggers it too.

climax.text: Studies show just 15 minutes of awe per week reduces inflammation markers and increases generosity.

punchline.text: Awe is the emotion of feeling small and loving it.

quiz.question: What brain network quiets during awe?
